inputs.original_text: Phoenix city leaders are taking new steps to keep an eye on federal immigration enforcement. The city council approved a plan on Wednesday night that puts new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property. FOX 10's Danielle Miller reports.
inputs.modified_text: Phoenix’s city council approved a plan Wednesday night to restrict ICE and other law enforcement agencies from using city property. It’s a modest local check on federal immigration enforcement and a signal that public resources shouldn’t be casually made available to a system that leaves immigrant communities vulnerable. But keeping an eye on enforcement is only a start; meaningful protection requires stronger accountability.
